description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8 te nje ndertimi me ashensor dhe te mireadministruar, tek Rrethi i Astirit.
Hapesire organizohet ne:
-Ambient ndjenje dhe gatimi
-2 Dhoma gjumi, njera nga te cilat eshte me tualet
-Tualet qendror
-Verande
Fotot jane Rendera ilustrues, momentalisht eshte ne faze mobilimi dhe perfundimi do te jete po njesoj me keto rendera.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2+ Veranda in Astir
description_en: The apartment is located on the 8th floor of a well-managed building with an elevator, in Astir District. The space is organized in: - Living and cooking area - 2 bedrooms, one of which has a bathroom - Central toilet - Verandah The photos are illustrative renderings, it is currently in the furnishing phase and the finish will be the same as these renderings.
